description: This file defines a CKEditor plugin called 'placeholder' that adds placeholder functionality with commands, UI buttons, context menu integration, CSS styling, and dialog management.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.plugins.placeholder
classes.description: Object containing the createPlaceholder method for inserting placeholder elements.

methods.name: createPlaceholder
methods.description: Creates or replaces a placeholder span element in the editor, optionally returning its HTML or inserting it into the document.
